description: Five-day National Weather Service forecast for a US resort (daily high/low, text forecast, precipitation chance, wind) with a rough snow estimate derived from the forecast wording. NWS covers US resorts only; Canadian and Andes resorts return available=false.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_forecast

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

condition.description: PeakCam condition key derived from the text.

shortForecast.description: NWS short forecast text, e.g. `Snow Likely`.

snowInchesEstimate.description: Keyword heuristic from the forecast text (blizzard/heavy snow 8, snow 3, flurries 1, else 0). Not a quantitative forecast; say so when quoting it.

title: Resort forecast
